title.zh: Ritual 主网上线并推出原生代币 RITUAL，同步登陆 Coinbase
title.en: Ritual launches mainnet and native RITUAL token with Coinbase listing

current_state.zh: Decentralized AI compute platform Ritual launched its mainnet and native RITUAL token with 18% of the 100 billion initial supply unlocked at launch, a 5% annual staking-driven inflation with EIP-1559 burns, and a 50 million token airdrop, alongside a Coinbase spot listing on October 26.
current_state.en: Decentralized AI compute platform Ritual launched its mainnet and native RITUAL token with 18% of the 100 billion initial supply unlocked at launch, a 5% annual staking-driven inflation with EIP-1559 burns, and a 50 million token airdrop, alongside a Coinbase spot listing on October 26.

updates.what_changed_zh: Ritual launched its mainnet and native RITUAL token, with Coinbase hosting the token's first exchange listing, backed by a token model where autonomous AI agents pay for inference and compute, validators settle tasks, insiders are locked for a year, and LayerZero handles cross-chain transfers.
